text:
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Deploy finished: model=redwood-v2 weightset=ws-2026-03-15-1 canary=5%

sara: Heads up — canary latency is fine but outputs look garbled, lots of broken tokens and odd punctuation. sample: "Hello world"

mike: Confirming, I see tokenization mismatch on a few prompts vs v1.9 on the same input. Likely tokenizer config drift or wrong tokenizer bundle shipped with weightset.

ops_jay: Paging oncall — patterns look like tokenizer-vocab mismatch, some tokens mapping to control chars. @oncall-anne can you pick this up? :rotating_light:

oncall-anne: on it. grabbing logs now. can you post a reproducible input?

support-olivia: We have two customers in prod reporting corrupted responses, one with hallucination-like output. They've filed high-priority cases. I'm escalating to SOC level 2.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Severity: P1 — Model output corruption detected. Triggered by alerts: model-output-error-rate > 2% across canary nodes. Incident channel: #incidents.

oncall-anne: quick checks: canary nodes show token error spikes at t+30s after deploy. KV cache warmups look normal. I suspect the tokenizer mapping file didn't get version pinned.

mike: I pulled the weightset metadata — weightset baked with tokenizer_ref: tokenizer/v2.0-release but our artifact registry has tokenizer/v2.0-release:sha=deadbeef vs expected sha=feedface. mismatch.

sara: So the model binary expects vocab X but we shipped vocab Y. That explains control chars replacing tokens. Repro steps: 
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","prompt":"Hello world"}'
2) response contains "" sequences.

ops_jay: Impact: canary at 5% — should be limited, but if autoscale or routing adjusted could hit more. Support reports indicate a handful of sessions hit production via canary routing. We should kill the feature flag to stop routing to v2 immediately.

oncall-anne: Acknowledge. Toggling feature flag now: 

```
# kill traffic to v2
featurectl set model_v2_route 0% --env prod --actor oncall-anne
```

oncall-anne: flag flip done. Monitoring for traffic drain...

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Route change applied: model_v2_route -> 0% by oncall-anne. Canary traffic drained to 0%.

statuspage-bot: Drafted status update: "We are investigating degraded responses for a recent model rollout. Traffic has been routed away from the release while we triage." Ready for review.

support-olivia: Notifying impacted customers in cases 3452 and 3470 that we've rolled traffic back and are investigating root cause.

mike: Next step: rollback or republish weightset with correct tokenizer SHA. Which is faster?

sara: Rolling weights forward with corrected tokenizer requires a rebuild and validation run (~30-45m). Rollback to v1.9 should be <10m and reduces blast radius. Recommend immediate rollback on canary group and hold full rollout.

eng-ryan: I can own the rollback. Executing safe rollback to pinned v1.9 on canary and dedicated pools where v2 landed. Command: 

```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --model redwood-v2 --to-version v1.9 --scope=canary,dedicated --force-safe
```

eng-ryan: rollback job submitted. watching.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Rollback started: target_version=v1.9 initiated_by=eng-ryan job=rb-2045678901-1

oncall-anne: Observability check: token error rate trending to baseline now. Latency steady. Customer errors should decrease within next minute as canary requests drain.

support-olivia: Confirmed with customer — their repeated test now looks normal. I'll update the cases and mark as mitigated.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Mitigation: feature flag toggled and rollback initiated. Severity remains P1 until we confirm no residual impact.

ops_jay: Quick forensic: why did tokenizer sha mismatch happen? preliminary: CI published tokenizer artifact with new tag but our deploy manifest referenced the tag instead of immutable sha. We'll need a policy change.

mike: Agreed. Also add a pre-deploy check to validate tokenizer SHA matches weightset expected sha as part of the rollout pipeline.

eng-ryan: Rollback completed on all canary and dedicated nodes. job rb-2045678901-1 succeeded.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Rollback succeeded: job=rb-2045678901-1 duration=5m12s

oncall-anne: Monitoring shows metrics back to normal. closing immediate mitigation. Postmortem owner assigned: eng-ryan.

eng-ryan: I'll own the postmortem. Tentative timeline: preliminary report in 24h, full postmortem in 72h. Action items I'm assigning now:
- CI/Artifact: enforce immutable-sha references (owner: mike)
- Deploy pipeline: add tokenizer sha verification step (owner: sara)
- Support comms: finalize customer notifications and status page (owner: support-olivia)

statuspage-bot: Update posted: "Resolved — traffic routed away from impacted release and rollback completed. Customers with cases have been notified. Full postmortem forthcoming."

oncall-anne: Closing channel for now. If anything regresses, reopen or ping oncall. :white_check_mark:

sara: fyi I'll prototype a quick unit test that validates tokenizer-vocab outputs against a small prompt suite before deploy.

support-olivia: Thanks team. Customers appreciative of quick action.

mike: Good catch. we'll follow up in postmortem.
